name: Popcorn Moon
blurb: Rises over the field and goes pop at midnight.

name: Homing Stork
blurb: Knows the way home from anywhere and never asks directions.

name: Dragon Dart
blurb: Darts over the koi pond on paper wings and winks at the Long Wall.

name: Great White Plumelet
blurb: The great white owl’s finest feather, dipped in aurora light.

name: Gale Islander
blurb: A pocket crab with a whole tiny island on its back, palm trees and all.

name: Tiger Moth Locket
blurb: A wing eyespot kept like a locket, glowing softly like a lantern.

name: Trail Dassie
blurb: A chibi rock dassie sitting on the ash trail, sniffing a protea as if it were cake.

name: Saltblock Minecart
blurb: A little mine cart piled with salt blocks that rumbles down the galleries and sings at every bend.

name: Songline Kangaroo
blurb: A little kangaroo wayfarer who points a paw along the song and hops the whole way home.

name: Hut Dweller
blurb: A round mud hut with a thatched roof and a lit doorway, who opens up for every late drummer.

name: Abbot Lemon
blurb: A wise lemon-faced abbot who blesses every fruit and keeps the best one for himself.

name: Minty Fez Vendor
blurb: A little fez with a friendly face who sells every spice with a wink and a cup of mint tea.

name: Chestwatch Goldfish
blurb: A plump goldfish who guards the sunken chest and fans a fin at the echoes.

name: Supervising Billy
blurb: A woolly goat on the wall who watches the harvest and takes one grape for his trouble.

name: Splinter Paw Panda
blurb: A serious panda who holds up one paw to show a splinter, then nibbles shoots like a judge.

name: Starwise Cheerer
blurb: A navigator in a bright headband who cheers when the stars line up.

name: Plumetail Digger
blurb: A chibi red squirrel with a great plume of tail, perched on a crate beside the glowing amber.

name: Twinhump Stroller
blurb: A chibi two-humped camel in a red saddle blanket, strolling in with the oasis every morning.

name: Scarlet Riddlecaller
blurb: A chibi scarlet macaw on the top terrace, calling every riddle out loud for the climbers.
